interpretation.plain_speak: This is the clean capacity wall. Sixteen simultaneous entities work perfectly. At twenty, exactly four fall out; at twenty-four, exactly eight fall out. The language router still understands every STORE, OBSERVE, and REPORT, so the failures come from the 16-slot memory limit itself—not from unfamiliar names or grammar.
interpretation.north_star_question: Establishes the true fixed-capacity entity-concurrency boundary for integrated language, separating memory capacity from temporal depth and routing generalization.
interpretation.next_stage: keep 24 entities and the 16-entry cap fixed, then compare preregistered nonadaptive working-set schedules that interleave STORE/OBSERVE/REPORT in bounded chunks against the all-stores baseline to test whether sequence organization can avoid overflow without adding memory
